map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation params to Google Gemini format with n and size
transform_image_generation_request: transform an image generation prompt into Gemini API request body format
transform_image_generation_response: transform a Gemini image generation HTTP response into litellm ImageResponse format
get_complete_url: build the full Gemini API URL for image generation based on model name
validate_environment: validate the environment by checking for a valid Gemini API key and setting headers
